In January, Owen hosted the SYNT workshop at the [UZH Science Lab](https://www.sciencelab.uzh.ch/en.html) — the university's hands-on venue for connecting science with schools, teachers, and the public through interactive workshops and exhibits.

The Science Lab's format is built around doing rather than just listening: participants work through activities and experiments pitched at their class level, across subjects from biology and chemistry to physics, sustainability, and digitalisation. Hosting a workshop there is a chance to bring the group's own thinking — about ecological forecasting, food webs, and how ecosystems respond to change — to an audience well outside the usual academic seminar room.
